subject: Shiny + scatter3d gives a weird error not all arguments have the same length

messages.author: 08f2932ad8066536
messages.subject: Shiny + scatter3d gives a weird error not all arguments have the same length
parts:
Hello,

I've never used Shiny. I get the following error when I am trying to used scatter3d to plot -> not all arguments have the same length

I am unsure how to fix this. My UI code is quite simple. 3 drop downs that allow me to pick through some variables. This works fine and behaves as I would expect.

library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("3 Dimensional Cluster Analysis"),
  sidebarLayout( 
  sidebarPanel(
  selectInput("test", "X-Axis", choices=c("Amount","Age") , selected="Age", width = NULL, size = NULL),
  selectInput("test2", "Y-Axis", choices=colnames(df.output) , selected="Transaction", width = NULL, size = NULL),
  selectInput("test3", "Z-Axis", choices=colnames(df.output) , selected="Bonus", width = NULL, size = NULL)

    
  ),
  mainPanel(
    rglwidgetOutput("plot",  width = 1000, height = 500)
  )
))

My problem is the server code:

library(shiny) library(car) library(rgl) server <- (function(input, output) { output$plot <- renderRglwidget( { rgl.open(useNULL=T) scatter3d( x = paste("df.output$",input$test,sep="") y = df.output$amt_scale, z = df.output$freq_scale, groups = as.factor(df.output$Cluster), grid=FALSE, surface=FALSE, ellipsoid=TRUE, ellipsoid.alpha=0.5, fit=smooth, xlab=input$test, ylab=input$test2, zlab=input$test3 ) par3d(mouseMode = "trackball") rglwidget() }) })

In particular are the highlighted lines. If I replace x = paste("df.output$",input$test,sep=""), with df.output$Age it works. However when I replace it with the variable it spits out that error. There are no NAs in my data frame, and the data all has the same number of rows.

Any help would be appreciated!
